task_context.problem_statement: Sandy earns $15 per hour. She worked 10 hours on Friday with her best friend, 6 hours on Saturday alone and 14 hours on Sunday with her other co-workers. How much money did Sandy earn in all on Friday, Saturday and Sunday?
task_context.reference_solution:
The total number of hours Sandy worked on Friday, Saturday and Sunday was 10 + 6 + 14 = <<10+6+14=30>>30 hours.
Beth made 30 × $15 = $<<30*15=450>>450 in those 3 days.
#### 450
